William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

On H[ayley] the Pickthank: I write the rascal thanks, till he and I

VIII
I 
WRITE
 the rascal thanks, till he and I
With thanks and compliments are quite drawn dry.
